title: Number of Fatalities
description: Number of fatalities due to workplace incidents (as reported to relevant authorities).

title: Lost Time Injury Frequency Rate (LTIFR)
description: LTIFR = (Total number of lost time injuries × 1,000,000) / Total number of hours worked.

title: Permanent Disabilities
description: Number of permanent disabilities reported due to workplace incidents.

title: Energy Intensity
description: Energy intensity = Total energy consumed / Total Revenue from Operations (PPP-adjusted).

title: Share of Energy from Renewable Sources
description: Percentage of total energy consumption derived from renewable sources.

title: Total Energy Consumed
description: Total energy consumed, with breakdown of renewable vs non-renewable energy sources; energy measured in Joules or multiples.

title: GHG Emission Intensity by Product/Service Output
description: GHG emission intensity (Scope 1+2) per unit of product or service output; include company- and sector-specific indicators as applicable.

title: Total Emission (Scope 1 & 2), Revenue & PPP for Intensity
description: 1) Total Emission (Scope 1 & 2); 2) Total Revenue from Operations (audited P&L); 3) PPP (USD/INR).

title: GHG Emission Intensity (Scope 1 + 2) – by Revenue
description: Emission intensity calculated as Total Scope 1 + Scope 2 emissions (MT CO2e) divided by Total Revenue from Operations adjusted for PPP.

title: Scope 1: Absolute Fossil Fuel Consumption
description: Absolute Fossil Fuel Consumption (coal, natural gas, diesel, fuel oil, etc.) must be disclosed in Mn MT / KT / MT / MM BTU, as part of Scope 1 emissions measurement.

title: Scope 1: Quantity of Carbon Capture
description: Quantity of Carbon Capture (Mn MT / KT / MT) to report any carbon capture occurring within Scope 1 boundaries.

title: Scope 1: Emission Factor
description: Emission Factor (GHG in CO2e per unit of measure) used for Scope 1 calculations, specified as IPCC factors or actual testing from accredited labs.

title: Scope 1: Fugitive Emissions
description: Fugitive emissions related to Scope 1 sources must be disclosed.

title: Scope 1: GHG Emissions by Non-Fuel Processes
description: GHG emissions in CO2e by process (non-fuel source) to be reported (Mn MT / KT / MT).

title: Scope 1: Total Scope 1 GHG Emissions
description: Total Scope 1 GHG emissions calculated as: Point 2 x Point 1 - Point 3 + Point 4 + Point 5, with breakdowns as applicable.

title: Scope 2: GHG Emission Factor Across Purchased Energy
description: GHG emission factor across all purchased energy sources (IPCC or supplier-certified) used to compute Scope 2 emissions.

title: Scope 2: Total Scope 2 GHG Emissions
description: Total Scope 2 GHG emissions = Total Consumption x Emission Factor.

title: Scope 2: Total Consumption of Purchased Energy
description: Total electricity, steam, cooling, etc., purchased energy consumption to be disclosed (e.g., MW, MT, MMBTU).

title: Gender Diversity: Gross Wages to Females as % of Wages
description: Gross wages paid to females as a percentage of total wages paid (In %).

title: Input Material Sourced from MSMEs/Indian Small Producers

title: Place of Employment Classification

title: Number of Dealers/Distributors
description: Number of dealers/distributors to whom sales are made.

title: Number of Trading Houses Purchasing From

description: Purchases from the top 10 trading houses as a percentage of total purchases from trading houses.

title: Biomedical Waste (C) – Kg/MT
description: Biomedical waste generated (solids and liquids) as per Bio-medical waste management rules 2016 and amendments.

title: Construction & Demolition Waste (D) – Kg/MT

title: Disposal Method by Category

title: E-waste (B) – Kg/MT
description: Discarded electronic waste (computers, TVs, cell phones, etc.) as defined under e-waste management rules 2016 and amendments.

title: Incineration Waste Disposition
description: Amount of material disposed through incineration (Kg/MT).

title: Waste Intensity
description: Waste intensity = Total waste generated / PPP-adjusted revenue (Kg or MT per rupee/USD).

title: Landfill Waste Disposition
description: Amount of material disposed to landfill (Kg/MT).

title: Other Waste Disposition
description: Amount disposed by any other method (Kg/MT).

title: Other Hazardous Waste (G) – Kg/MT
description: Other hazardous waste as per CPCB hazardous waste management rules; specify if any.

title: Other Non-Hazardous Waste (H) – Kg/MT
description: Other non-hazardous waste generated (breakdown by composition) as per CPCB guidelines.

title: Plastic Waste (A) – Kg/MT
description: Plastic waste (A) – absolute weight of packaging material discarded as defined under plastic waste management rules 2016 and amendments.

title: Radioactive Waste (F) – Kg/MT
description: Discarded material with exposure to radiation from nuclear power plants, hospitals, laboratories, etc., as per applicable rules.

title: Waste Recovered by Category
description: For each waste category, disclose total waste recovered through recycling, re-use, or other recovery operations (Kg/MT).

title: Total Waste Generated
description: Total waste generated = sum of wastes A through H (Kg / MT).

title: Water Consumption Intensity
description: Water consumption intensity = Total water consumed / Total Revenue from Operations (PPP-adjusted).

title: Water Discharge by Destination & Treatment Levels
description: Discharge of water by destination with levels of treatment: Untreated, Primary, Secondary, Tertiary treatment; measured in Mn Lt or KL.

title: Water Footprint: Total Water Consumption
description: Total water consumption in Mn Liters or KL, with definition of water consumed as water withdrawn and not released back to ecosystems; acceptable calculation methods include input/output flow logs.
